ctx.x: I know all about that stuff in the South, but I didn't realize it was all out here, too.

Actually, right at the Paramount Studio, that same studio up on Melrose now, they had this little old bitty restaurant across the street, where when you got a break for lunch... They didn't have a studio commissary in those days; at least I didn't see any in Paramount Studios. So everybody would go across the street at this restaurant. L.Z. Cooper was in the band at the time, and Papa Mutt, and I can't think who else. But I know Ram and I, Minor Hall, we still had these straw hats on, and we walked across there,…
